topSignals.title: Bloom Energy posts Q3 2026 revenue of $1.24B, up 138% YoY, and raises FY2026 guidance for the third time this year.
topSignals.text: Product revenue reached $1,073.6M (+179.4% YoY); non-GAAP gross margin rose to 34.5% (+412bps); non-GAAP operating income was $285.7M (up $239.4M YoY); adjusted EBITDA hit $299.5M versus $59.0M a year earlier. New FY2026 guidance: $4.4-4.6B revenue (~122% growth at midpoint), non-GAAP EPS $3.10-3.40. No backlog or manufacturing-capacity figure was disclosed in the release itself; the CEO described AI/hyperscaler demand as now spreading into other market segments. SEC 8-K

topSignals.title: New SOFC entrant: Petra Power
topSignals.text: , a ~15-person, DoD-funded (~$9M in contracts) solid oxide fuel cell startup (founded 2017 on a NASA Glenn license) now publicly pitching compact, modular SOFC systems to AI data centers and military ground vehicles, per an Oct 10 TechCrunch interview. No commercial deployment or named hyperscaler commitment yet; first infrastructure deployment targeted for 2028, volume production for 2029. Added to the benchmark watch list — no disclosed KPI figures of its own yet (it cites only generic DOE SOFC averages). remio.ai

items.text: Elcogen (priority): No new News-category item since Sept 21 (Metrosert cooperation), confirmed by direct fetch today. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (75% FC electrical efficiency / 90% with heat recovery, 33 kWh/kg H2 SOEC — vendor claims) in volume production at the 360 MW/yr ELCO I Tallinn factory.

Topsoe (priority): No new solid-oxide-specific release since Aug 27 (H1 2026 results/SOEC pathway reset), confirmed by direct fetch today; topsoe.com/press-releases remains dominated by SAF/ammonia/e-methanol contract news, out of SOFC/SOEC scope.
New entrant — Petra Power: see Top Signal #2. US startup, DoD-funded, pre-commercial, no hyperscaler agreement; flagged as a background watch item, not yet a benchmark-register entry.

Delta Electronics: Results were the already-logged Delta-Ceres fuel-cell/electrolysis technology license and the Delta/MODEC/Eld Energy floating-platform (FPSO) SOFC collaboration — both pre-dated, no new 2026 item.
Shell: Results were the already-logged Shell-Ceres 10 MW pressurized-SOEC electrolyser design project; an enkiai.com "2026 SOFC strategy" aggregator piece added no verifiable new detail.
Denso: Results were enkiai.com aggregator pieces recycling Denso's 2025 SOEC program and legacy Nishio-plant SOFC-cogeneration coverage — no new 2026 company disclosure.
Thermax: Results were the standing Thermax-Ceres green-hydrogen licensing partnership and Thermax's own SOEC technology page — no new dated item.
This completes cycle 3 of the weekly benchmark rotation (started Oct 19, round 1); a new cycle 4 begins tomorrow with Bloom Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, FuelCell Energy, Mitsubishi Power.

Sweep 2 — "Reverion OR Convion OR Hexis OR SolydEra": No new item; results were the already-logged Sept 29 Reverion $175M/€150M Series B and Convion's historical Wärtsilä fuel-cell-business acquisition.
